verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a shared 'consent model' across SDKs and features to 'honor consent, and control what gets captured' for session replay, implying some opt-out/consent tooling exists in its data-collection stack, but there is no dedicated documentation about an AI-native user opting out of Amplitude's own telemetry or usage tracking of the product itself. missing for 10: explicit opt-out/DNT mechanism documentation, privacy policy specifics for AI-native/developer users, independent confirmation that consent controls actually block tracking.
